purpose.summary: Canonical interpretation layer for the local clinical automation pipeline.
intendedUse: Define canonical entities, fields, meanings, and relationships.
Define deterministic classification, mapping, validation, and routing rules.
Separate confirmed rules from deferred, unresolved, or provisional behavior.
Provide a source of truth for future parser, mapper, validator, regression, and POGS-integration changes.
notFor: Credentials, tokens, passwords, or OAuth configuration

changePolicy.rule: Changes to canonical mappings, required-field rules, schema meanings, or routing behavior should be validated against regression evidence before promotion.

RawCase.description: Local source-oriented snapshot of one Google Docs clinical case.

rawCaseId.meaning: Stable pseudonymous local identity derived deterministically from Google documentId.

documentId.meaning: Google Docs source identity. Sensitive operational identifier; do not place in shareable semantic artifacts.

googleDoc.meaning: Raw Google Docs API response. May contain PHI and remains local.

POGSCandidate.description: Structured object prepared for local POGS validation/write logic.

KnowledgeRecord.description: Sanitized semantic/regression representation of one processed case.

RegressionEvidenceBundle.description: Historical regression artifact containing the sanitized knowledge records and regression summary from the same run.
RegressionEvidenceBundle.purpose: Primary shareable evidence artifact for reviewing parser/mapping/rule behavior without raw PHI.

rawCaseFolderSemantics.invariant: A rawCaseId must exist in exactly one workflow folder at a time.

new.meaning: Discovered and archived; automated processing has not successfully completed.
new.entryRule: Every unseen Google document is first written here.

for_checking.meaning: Automation and local POGS processing/verification succeeded; manual review is required.
for_checking.entryRule: Move here only after successful local POGS processing and verification.

gaps.meaning: Blocking automated issue or human-detected error, ambiguity, missing value, unsupported rule, or incorrect result requires investigation.

completed.meaning: Human-reviewed and accepted. Ready for the existing POGS/cloud submission process.

deduplication.ifFound: Do not create a new raw file.
deduplication.ifNotFound: Create exactly one raw file in new.

mixedPregnancyGyne.meaning: A case may simultaneously satisfy current-pregnancy and gynecologic classification rules. Do not force the flags to be mutually exclusive.
mixedPregnancyGyne.readinessPolicy: If isPregnancy is true, the pregnancy-specific blocking rule remains sufficient to keep readyForPOGS false until pregnancy validation is implemented. Gyne extraction and mapping may still be evaluated and recorded.

endometrialSampling.canonicalLabel: Status post ultrasound guided endometrial sampling

confirmed.notes: gyneStage 6 is treated as the POGS/frontend value used for this nonmalignant diagnosis and is not independently inferred as a literal clinical cancer stage.

explicitNonMappings.reason: Source wording does not establish endometrial hyperplasia.

unresolved.reason: No exact confirmed POGS gynecologicalDiagnosis reference.
No exact confirmed source-to-POGS diagnosis mapping.

neitherPregnancyNorGyne.issue: Neither pregnancy nor gyne case is selected

ifIsGyne.issue: Gyne case has no confirmed POGS gynecologicalDiagnosis mapping

pregnancy.meaning: Pregnancy cases may parse successfully but must remain blocked until the separate pregnancy-specific rules are implemented and explicitly validated.

readyForPOGS.definition: True only when there are zero blocking validation issues.
readyForPOGS.regressionOverride: Even if validation is ready, REGRESSION mode must not enter the live POGS write branch.

cloudSubmission.boundary: n8n must stop before the existing POGS cloud-submission action.

REGRESSION.purpose: Replay archived cases through normalization, parsing, classification, mapping, candidate building, validation, knowledge generation, and regression comparison.

mappingCoverage.mappedTerms: Recognized terms with confirmed POGS mapping.
mappingCoverage.unresolvedTerms: Recognized terms without a confirmed automatic mapping.
mappingCoverage.ignoredTerms: Recognized terms intentionally excluded from the target diagnosis field.

mappingStatus.mappingComplete: True when no recognized mapping-relevant term remains unresolved under current rules.
mappingStatus.needsClinicalMappingReview: True when unresolved mapping-relevant terms require review.

ruleStatus.unsatisfiedRequiredRules: Required applicable rules known to be unsatisfied.
ruleStatus.needsRuleReview: True when rule behavior needs manual/engineering review.

discovery.unknownTopLevelFields: Unexpected knowledge-record fields not in the canonical schema.

statuses.NEW: No previous comparable knowledge record exists.
statuses.IMPROVED: Current result reduces known problems or improves readiness according to comparison metrics.
statuses.REGRESSED: Current result introduces or increases known problems.
statuses.CHANGED: Comparable semantic content changed without a classified improvement/regression.

regressionSemantics.binaryReadRequirement: Use this.helpers.getBinaryDataBuffer with the correct item index; do not assume binary item 0 for multi-item comparisons.

evidenceBundle.qualityRule: Regression evidence bundles should contain semantic knowledge content and regression results only; n8n transport metadata and previous-file lookup errors must be removed before writing the bundle.

intentionalPolicyTransitions.rule: A deliberate tightening of validation may appear as REGRESSED relative to an older permissive baseline even when the new behavior is correct.
handling: Review whether the changed rule is intentional and represented in the semantic layer.
Do not automatically revert a safety-tightening change merely because status is REGRESSED.
After accepting the intentional policy change, use the next unchanged regression as the new behavioral baseline.

comparisonIntegrity.rule: Regression status must reflect semantic processing differences only. Execution context, transport metadata, read-file errors used only to detect previous-record absence, and other operational fields must not affect semantic equality.

currentEvidence.sourceType: sanitized regression evidence bundle plus established workflow/source reverse-engineering decisions

latestRegressionEvidence.baselineInterpretation: This run expands evidence to 29 cases. NEW cases dominate because many records had no prior knowledge baseline. CHANGED/REGRESSED cases must be interpreted only after execution and lookup metadata are excluded from comparison.

knownGaps.impact: Pregnancy candidates remain not-ready until separate pregnancy-specific validation is implemented.
knownGaps.latestEvidence: 27 of 29 current cases are classified pregnancy and are blocked by the pending pregnancy rule.

knownGaps.impact: Current run contains 9 gyne-classified cases with no confirmed gynecologicalDiagnosis mapping.
knownGaps.rule: Do not guess POGS reference IDs; confirm mappings from POGS source/reference behavior before promotion.

knownGaps.impact: Seven current cases are classified both pregnancy and gyne. Dual classification is allowed; pregnancy blocking still controls readiness until pregnancy validation exists.
Many new knowledge records contain an operational 'error: No file(s) found' field from previous-knowledge lookup. This is not semantic data and must be stripped from comparison and evidence bundles.
One of 29 cases lacks extracted height. Height remains non-blocking and produces a warning.

sourcePriority.source: Confirmed POGS source/reference behavior and API/frontend reverse engineering
sourcePriority.useFor: POGS IDs, stored shapes, endpoint behavior, reference semantics
Actual parser, classifier, mapper, candidate, and validator behavior
Observed behavior across real local cases
Correctness feedback and discovery of unsupported/ambiguous behavior

whenToUpdateThisFile: A POGS reference mapping is confirmed or rejected.
A canonical field is added, removed, or redefined.
A human-reviewed gap establishes a new deterministic rule.
requiredEvidenceForConfirmedMapping: POGS reference/source confirmation or deterministic application evidence
